scope: Observed cases and exact final delivery identities; not a shared skin, quota, extra review stage or future acceptance.

findings.cause: One-line and two-line real deadlines moved benefit/date/divider tracks although CTA bottoms and numeric checks passed.
findings.prevention: Inspect full real neighbor groups at actual narrow widths; choose purpose-specific tracks, not a universal card template.

findings.cause: A narrow-tablet grid retained four columns and a phone name shared width with the arrow. The home subset concealed additional full-directory cases.
findings.prevention: Inspect complete merchant data, glyph paint, counts, arrows and actual height at chosen breakpoint neighbors and320px; reflow without shrinking or clipping.

findings.cause: Photo/background integration changed the final red field. Large black heading remained compliant but normal16/18px black caption fell to3.7249.
findings.prevention: Recompute actual normal and large text contrast after image/background changes; validate the real final text region.

findings.cause: Outer form size did not prove the actual input hit box; a complete official logo needed a correct optical variant/backing.
findings.prevention: Measure actual controls and inspect original logo pixels in every static and dynamic role.

findings.cause: One-line and two-line merchant names shifted counts and arrows in the complete store directory although names remained readable.
findings.prevention: Check the complete real merchant set and neighboring breakpoint widths; align the brand-specific metadata tracks without copying another site skin.

findings.cause: Nonempty generic offer titles omitted merchant identity and single-merchant category counts used plural nouns.
findings.prevention: Check real TDK meaning and zero/single/plural text; preserve source offer conditions and avoid fabricated identifier uniqueness.

findings.cause: The actual zero-result filtered state was correct, but the scanner omitted its explicit data-list-empty marker.
findings.prevention: Preserve old receipts, recognize only visible main empty states with no populated coupons, test hidden/outside/populated counterexamples and remeasure the affected state with the corrected native tool.

findings.cause: Expiry removed the selected related coupons but left an empty recommendation heading and divider.
findings.prevention: Check the containing module after removing records; honor its declared empty strategy in static and runtime states, scope the empty copy accurately, and verify idempotence, recovery and retained merchant recommendations.

findings.cause: Long code wrapping, logo mapping, shared action tracks and actual responsive boundaries required additional source-scoped fixes.
findings.prevention: Keep old sources, concentrate actual defects, freeze new candidates and recheck the exact offline/archive/current download.

evidenceBoundary: Native full-site reviews and release ran in the retained proofStoreRoot. Published source/archive copies are byte-identical; native receipt paths were never edited. User visual acceptance remains not-recorded.
